headline: Callums Cape Bleeds On; Stonecradle Front Falls Silent
war_summary: Three hours on, the storm holds its shape while other sectors hush. Callums Cape remains the bloodiest field: two-hour losses of some thirty-four hundred men between the armies have cooled from the morning pace, yet flag fighting was logged to the filing hour at Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire, with forty-four base changes in the day. Mooring County runs close behind, its hourly count climbing again about The Wind Hills, where the work has been thickest. Weathered Expanse keeps up its exchange, Crow's Nest now the busiest post, and Linn Mercy's flags still turn at Outwich Ranch, the hourly rate quickening. Marban Hollow's casualty surge continues near Checkpoint Bua, though no fresh flag movement has been recorded there in two hours. Stonecradle, brisk at the last edition, has gone still since mid-afternoon about The Dais. The Nevish Line remains flag-silent since early morning, Callahans Passage since the previous evening, and Godcrofts since forenoon. One fresh note from the outposts: Wardens carried a post at The Squall in Lykos Isle shortly before this edition closed. It is the 793rd day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
